rows.label: Formula
rows.text:
Critical thinking = questioning evidence, not rejecting everything — show balanced reasoning.
Structure: claim → evidence → evaluation → conclusion; examiners reward this order.

rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: Trick 1: Identify the fallacy bank: hasty generalisation, ad hominem, false cause, appeal to emotion — naming the flaw in an argument is the unit's core skill.  ·  Trick 2: Evaluate claims with the CARS test: Claim, Assumptions, Reasons/evidence, Standard of proof — a quick scaffold for 'do you agree?' questions.

rows.label: Board question
rows.text: Q. Identify one weakness in the writer's argument. (2 marks) — name the fallacy (e.g. hasty generalisation) and quote the offending line.
